source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: This aura affects each friendly **WAR DOG** model no farther than 6″ from the Chaos Cerastus Knight Acheron. As either [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) opens, every enemy in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of an affected **WAR DOG** unit takes a [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock).

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
